items.title: The Pentagon Launches Its Own Versions of ChatGPT and Grok for Secure Operations
items.summary: The U.S. Pentagon has developed and deployed its own secure, internal large language models, akin to ChatGPT and Grok, for classified operations and enhanced national security applications.

items.title: Apple Presents 'Shocking Evidence' Against Ex-Employee Accused of Stealing Data for OpenAI
items.summary: Apple has reportedly presented compelling evidence in a legal case against a former employee accused of intellectual property theft, specifically for allegedly sharing company data with OpenAI.

items.title: Polimill Partners with OpenAI to Build Japan's Next-Generation Public AI Infrastructure
items.summary: Polimill, in collaboration with OpenAI, is developing a cutting-edge public AI infrastructure for Japan, aiming to accelerate national AI capabilities and innovation.

items.title: OpenAI Expands Access to AI with ChatGPT Ads
items.summary: OpenAI announces a significant step in democratizing AI by introducing advertisements within ChatGPT, aiming to broaden access and make advanced AI tools available to a wider audience.

items.title: LoopArena: Benchmarking Models as Runtime Controllers for Loop Engineering
items.summary: Researchers introduce LoopArena, a new benchmark for evaluating AI models' ability to act as runtime controllers for optimizing loop engineering, a critical aspect of efficient code execution.

items.title: DART-SD: Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents
items.summary: A new method, DART-SD, is proposed for improving multi-turn tool-calling AI agents through diamond-topology aware retrieval and tuning for self-distillation, enhancing their ability to use tools effectively.

items.title: Instagram Imposes New Restrictions on Undisclosed AI-Generated Profiles
items.summary: Instagram is implementing stricter policies to limit and identify AI-generated profiles that do not clearly disclose their artificial nature, aiming to enhance transparency and combat misinformation.

items.title: DreamX-Creator: Democratizing 2K Resolution Native Audio-Video Generation
items.summary: A new research paper introduces DreamX-Creator, a model designed to democratize the creation of high-resolution (2K) native audio-video content, making advanced generative AI more accessible.

items.title: Agentic Artifact Creation: Systems, Evaluation, Principles, and Opportunities
items.summary: This paper explores the emerging field of agentic artifact creation, outlining systems, evaluation methodologies, core principles, and future opportunities for AI agents to autonomously generate complex outputs.

items.title: Puro-2B: A Cost-Effective Qwen2-1.5B Model Trained on an RTX 5090
items.summary: Puro-2B demonstrates the feasibility of training a competitive Qwen2-1.5B language model on a single RTX 5090 GPU within a modest budget, highlighting advancements in accessible model development.

items.title: Better Answers, Broader Thinking: Students Gain from ChatGPT and Critical-Thinking Training
items.summary: A new study highlights that students who combine ChatGPT usage with critical-thinking training achieve better answers and develop broader cognitive skills, suggesting a synergistic learning approach.

items.title: Claude Code Costs Up to $200/Month, While Goose Offers Similar Functionality for Free
items.summary: A new report highlights a significant price disparity in AI coding assistants, noting that Claude Code can cost up to $200 monthly, while an alternative called Goose provides similar services for free.

items.title: Lucida: Composable Real-to-Sim Scene Modeling with Parse, Generate, and Place
items.summary: Lucida presents a novel approach for composable real-to-sim scene modeling by integrating parsing, generation, and placement techniques, enabling more realistic and flexible virtual environments.

items.title: Revisiting Local Context for Long-Horizon Streaming 3D Reconstruction
items.summary: New research re-examines the role of local context in achieving long-horizon streaming 3D reconstruction, proposing methods to improve consistency and accuracy over extended periods.

items.title: Building Needflare: An Autonomous Disaster Intelligence & Logistics Agent with Gemini 3.7, Gemma 4 & Google Veo
items.summary: Developers detail the creation of Needflare, an autonomous AI agent designed for disaster intelligence and logistics, leveraging advanced models like Gemini 3.7, Gemma 4, and Google Veo.
